description: This file defines the AzureAIClientFactory class, which provides methods to create and manage Azure Search clients and index clients with different authentication options.

classes.name: AzureAIClientFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating Azure Search clients with configurable authentication options.

methods.name: CreateSearchClient
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a cached SearchClient for a given index name, with proper authentication.

methods.name: CreateSearchIndexClient
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a cached SearchIndexClient with proper authentication.

methods.name: GetManagedIdentityCredential
methods.description: Returns a ManagedIdentityCredential using the configured identity client ID.
